离线 · 无上传 · 浏览器本地完成Offline · no uploads · runs in the browser

Markdown 转 PNG——离线、整篇排成长图、不上传Markdown to PNG offline — the whole document as one image

想把一份 README 或笔记「原样」甩进聊天工具，不必担心对面那套渲染器把它重新排版，一张图比一段文字可靠。这条路两步：`md>html` 用 marked 按 GFM 渲染（`gfm: true`，所以管道符表格、删除线、任务清单、自动链接都被认出；`breaks: false`，段落里单个换行仍是续行），渲染结果先过 DOMPurify（html + svg 两套 profile，因此**文档里内联的 SVG 图形不会被当垃圾删掉**——那是架构图与示意图最常见的写法），再由 `wrapHtmlDocument` 套上这份扩展自带的样式表；`html>png` 把净化后的文档离屏渲染成整页画布并无损编码成 PNG。图里看到的排版因此是这套样式决定的：正文最大宽度 800 px 居中、行高 1.7，表格 `border-collapse`、每个单元 1px 实线边框与内边距，表头与偶数行各带一层浅底，代码块是浅灰圆角块，`h1` 带一条下边线。三条边界照实说：**引用了网络地址或相邻路径的图片取不到字节**，因为渲染前先剥掉子资源引用（这既是离线主张也是渲染前提），结果卡会按张数披露丢了几张，被替换处留虚线方框；**整页高度上限是 32768 px**（`MAX_CANVAS_EDGE × 4`），超出报「渲染高度过大」而不是交付空白画布或被截短的图；**图里的文字不是文字**，PNG 没有文字层，不能选中、搜索或复制。全过程在这个标签页里完成，只有 storage 权限。When a README or a note has to land in a chat exactly as it reads — the receiving side has no renderer left to re-lay it with — one picture is more dependable than a block of text. Two steps: `md>html` renders through marked as GFM (`gfm: true`, so pipe tables, strikethrough, task lists and autolinks are recognised, while `breaks: false` keeps a single newline a soft wrap), the markup passes DOMPurify with the html and svg profiles, so **an inline SVG diagram is not deleted as junk** (the usual way people draw architecture sketches), and `wrapHtmlDocument` wraps it in the stylesheet this extension ships; `html>png` then renders the sanitised document offscreen and encodes the whole page losslessly as PNG. That stylesheet is what the picture shows: an 800 px centred measure with 1.7 line height, `border-collapse` tables with a 1px rule and padding on every cell, a tinted header row and alternating rows, code blocks as light rounded panels, `h1` underlined. Three boundaries, stated plainly: **images referenced by network address or a sibling path have no bytes available**, because sub-resource references are stripped before rendering (the offline guarantee and the rendering precondition are the same act), the result card discloses how many were lost and each replaced reference keeps a dashed placeholder; **one capture is bounded at 32768 px of height** (`MAX_CANVAS_EDGE × 4`) and past that the route reports “too tall to render” instead of delivering a blank canvas or a trimmed image; and **text in the picture is not text** — a PNG has no text layer, so nothing can be selected, searched or copied. All of it inside this tab on the storage permission.

这条链路怎么走How the route runs

MarkdownMarkdown →HTMLHTML →PNGPNG

共 2 步，由扩展的路径搜索自动选出，中间产物不落盘。2 steps, chosen by the extension's own path search; intermediate results never touch the disk.

会保留什么What carries over

  • 排版进图而不是文字进图：表头条纹、代码块底色、`h1` 下边线都按自带的样式表渲染出来The layout goes into the image: table striping, code-panel fills and the `h1` rule render exactly as the bundled stylesheet says
  • 行内 SVG 图形保留：html + svg 两套净化 profile，架构图不会因为「不是 HTML 标记」被整块删掉Inline SVG diagrams survive: the html and svg sanitising profiles mean an architecture sketch is not deleted for being markup
  • GFM 表格按表格渲染：管道符语法变成有边框与条纹的表，而不是一排竖线GFM tables render as tables, with borders and striping rather than a run of vertical bars
  • 无损编码：细线、小字号与色块边缘不糊，缩放查看时仍然锐利Lossless encoding: thin rules, small type and colour fields take no second compression pass, while zoom headroom follows the density chosen for the height

如实说明的限制What it does not do

  • 整页高度上限 32768 px：超长文档会报错并说明，不给被截短的图；要分页请走 Markdown→PDF 或 Markdown→JPGA 32768 px height ceiling: an over-long document fails with an explanation rather than a trimmed picture; take Markdown to PDF or JPG for pages
  • 引用的远程与相邻路径图片取不到字节：渲染前会剥掉这些引用，结果卡按张数披露，被替换的位置留虚线方框Images pointed at by a network address or a sibling path have no bytes: those references are stripped before rendering, the result card says how many were lost, and each replaced spot keeps a dashed placeholder
  • 图里的文字不可复制：没有文字层，不能选中、搜索或无障碍朗读出来Text inside the image cannot be copied: there is no text layer to select, search or read aloud
  • 质量与目标体积是有损容器才有的档位：面板对 PNG 不提供它们，编码器也会忽略；这一路可调的只有最长边，超出会重采样Quality and a target file size belong to lossy containers: the panel does not offer either for PNG and the encoder ignores them, so the only dial that applies here is the longest edge, which resamples when exceeded
  • 等宽代码块按 800 px 正文宽度排版，超长行会横向溢出到面板内部而不是折行——那是样式表的行为，图片忠实拍下Monospace code lays out inside the 800 px measure and very long lines overflow the panel rather than wrapping; that is the stylesheet’s behaviour and the image reproduces it faithfully

实操提示Working with it

  • 要能打印或分页的成品：Markdown→PDF，页面就是文档本身For something printable and paginated: Markdown to PDF, where the pages are the document
  • 要小体积的分享图：Markdown→JPG 走同一条渲染链再分页逐张有损编码For smaller shareable pictures: Markdown to JPG shares this rendering chain and then encodes pages lossily one by one
  • 要能复制与搜索的文本：Markdown→HTML、TXT 或 Word，图片这一路负责的是「看起来就是我写的」For copyable, searchable text: Markdown to HTML, TXT or Word — the image route is for looking exactly like what you wrote

常见问题Questions people actually ask

我的文档里有 Mermaid 画的图，会变成什么？What happens to a Mermaid diagram in my document?

取决于它在源文件里长什么样。已经被渲染成内联 `<svg>` 的图会保留并出现在图里（净化用的是 html + svg 两套 profile）；仍是 ```mermaid 围栏源码的那一种，这一步只负责渲染 Markdown，不会替你把它画出来，产物里看到的就是代码块文字。It depends on what is in the source. A diagram already written as inline `<svg>` is kept and shows up, because sanitising uses the html and svg profiles together. One still written as a ```mermaid fence is not drawn for you — this step renders Markdown, so the picture shows the code block’s text.

为什么图片位置是空的，还多了一块虚线框？Why is an image slot empty, with a dashed box there?

因为那些字节本来就不在文件里。这条路完全离线，渲染前会剥掉指向网络与相邻路径的子资源引用（否则「打开一张图就发了四次请求」会变成事实），替换掉的位置是一个虚线方框（只在克隆那一步失败的那种直接空着），结果卡按张数写明丢了几张。把图片另存进同一个目录并不能绕过它——剥的是引用，不是文件。Because those bytes were never in the file. The route is fully offline and strips sub-resource references to the network and to sibling paths before rendering — otherwise “open one image and fire four requests” would be true — so replaced slots keep a dashed box and the result card states how many were lost. Putting the images next to the file does not avoid it: what is removed is the reference, not the file.

一份很长的 Markdown 会出几张图？How many images does a long Markdown file produce?

一张：整页捕获是一整块画布，高度由内容决定，上限 32768 px，超出就报错。想要一页一张的形状，请走 Markdown→PDF 或 Markdown→JPG。One: a whole-page capture is a single canvas whose height follows the content, bounded at 32768 px, and beyond that the route fails. For one picture per page take Markdown to PDF or JPG.

不需要账号，也不需要联网：装好扩展后点图标，在新标签页里打开工作台，文件从磁盘直接选。No account and no network: install the extension, click its icon, and the workbench opens in a new tab reading straight off your disk.
